::: {#def-bigram-model}

#### Bigram model

A **bigram model** is a [language model](#def-language-model) in which the distribution of each symbol depends only on the symbol before it
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 12.4.1].
Counting in a training text estimates it as

$$
\hPr{}\paren{X_t = b \given X_{t-1} = a} = \frac{N(a, b)}{N(a)},
$$

where $N(a, b)$ counts how often $a$ is followed by $b$,
and $N(a)$ counts how often $a$ is followed by any symbol
[@jurafsky2026slp, section 3.1.2].
An $n$-gram model conditions on the $n - 1$ symbols before each one in the same way.

:::
